name: Ingrid Lindgren
action: Ingrid pauses a beat, then gives a small nod. “I may come. Who else is going?”
reason: Ingrid is tired, but Anna’s invitation feels like it matters enough to consider. The memory of past kräftskivor lingers for her, and she weighs whether the evening would have a useful point rather than being just noise and performative cheer. She does not want another pointless dinner, but she also does not want to dismiss Anna lightly, so she responds with cautious openness and asks who else will be there.
